beta.notes:
WireProof — Harness CAD 0.51.0 (beta). Harness CAD is now WireProof, powered by Engineering Solutions ApS.

- New name everywhere: window title, Help → About WireProof (with the Engineering Solutions "Powered by" logo), HTML export footer, installer and Start menu.
- New product: this installer does not upgrade Harness CAD. Uninstall Harness CAD first, then run WireProof-Setup-0.51.0.exe.
- Licenses are WireProof licenses now (keys start with WP-LIC-, machine codes with WPM-); a Harness CAD license does not open WireProof.
